retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s crooner album layout featuring a centered portrait over a teal background with horizontal musical staff lines and clean geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, warm-toned male portrait in a dark cardigan and tie, set against a teal-blue background textured with thin, dark horizontal lines resembling a musical score. The typography is dominated by a large, clean geometric sans-serif title at the top, with secondary track listings floating in the negative space to the right of the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones and dark clothing contrasting against a cool teal background
Large-scale title typography anchored to the top margin
Horizontal rhythmic lines providing texture and depth behind the subject
Asymmetrical track list placement balancing the central portrait

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered mid-shot portrait, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large yellow-and-white title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the horizontal lines to the track list on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant teal space at the top and sides, textured with fine lines to prevent flatness.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the primary title word
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation background against a low-value, high-detail subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular 'o' and 'e' and straight-cut terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Geometric proportions based on circles and squares
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' as a single-story geometric form
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight tracking of the era.
Classic mid-century geometric choice with similar weights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a dark 1960s cardigan and tie, centered against a solid teal background. Add a subtle texture of thin, dark horizontal lines across the entire background to mimic a musical staff.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large geometric sans-serif title at the top. Color the first word bright yellow and the rest white. Add a small grid of white track titles in a bold weight on the right side of the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the background teal with horizontal lines?
Is the title in a geometric sans-serif?
Is the first word of the title yellow?
Is the subject centered and wearing a dark cardigan?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure horizontal lines are perfectly parallel

recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Teal Background + Horizontal Staff Lines + Geometric Sans-Serif Title (Yellow/White Split)
